The plan

State, decisions and the first 30 days

If the VP reads only this, the message should be: the numbers are controlled, the campaign close is the first priority, and here is what I need from you.

State

Gift-to-GL is reconciled monthly. Close is targeted at day 6. January closed with $0 unexplained. One stock batch is held pending confirmation.

Decisions I need

NXT test access, a named Finance reviewer, spring appeal temporary help and a Blackbaud introduction. Those four unblock the first 30 days.

90-day outcomes

Day 6 close, ≥95% acknowledgments, 100% traceable releases and at least one trained backup for every critical process.

Watch list

Pledge schedule, NXT release and spring appeal capacity. Each has an owner, a date and a gate; none is hidden until the board report.

The work frame

AMDG is the why. SMARTER is the test.

Two checks sit above every role area. AMDG asks whether the work serves the mission and the people it is meant to serve. SMARTER asks whether the work is defined, measured, staffed, timed and reviewed.

AMDG

Ad Maiorem Dei Gloriam. For the greater glory of God.

The Ignatian purpose test. It keeps an operation from becoming self-referential: the work has to serve students, donors and the school’s mission, not just the process.

The check I apply to priorities, tradeoffs and how the team treats people.

AMDG donor reporting framework

In stewardship, every report answers four questions: what did the donor intend, what did the gift make possible, who did it serve, and where is the evidence?

Intent → Impact → Evidence → Stewardship

A

R

T

Data quality and coverage

Clean records are a daily control, not a cleanup project.

1.9%Audit error rate
38Duplicate pairs
94.2%Address validity

The 5% weekly sample drives a named refresher. Duplicates go to a person, never an automatic merge. The proposed Director, Database Administrator and Development & Stewardship Officer cover gift entry, records and reporting, with a trained backup for each critical step, subject to segregation of duties.

So what: one held batch, one suppressed email and one class-year mapping are visible before they become a donor problem. The Director can see the queue, the close and the system health on one page.

Project charter

Campaign close and pledge collection

The campaign is complete. The remaining work is collecting what was pledged, honoring restrictions and showing donors what their gifts did.

SponsorVP, Institutional Advancement
LeadDirector, Advancement Services
TeamDirector, DBA, Development & Stewardship Officer, Finance, Major Giving
GateReconciliation · Mar 26

Problem

Pledges, restricted gifts and endowed funds must be collected and reported against the signed agreements. A manual reconciliation at the end of the campaign would hide exceptions and delay stewardship.

Objective

Reconcile every open pledge and restricted fund, produce the campaign close pack, and hand a clean stewardship list to Major Giving by June 30.

In scope

  • Open pledge schedule and reminders
  • Restricted and endowed fund tie-out
  • Campaign close pack and audit evidence
  • Stewardship list and donor impact data

Out of scope

  • New campaign planning
  • Gift acceptance policy changes
  • Investment management
  • Donor solicitation strategy

Research, qualification and portfolio discipline

Prospect development is not a list of names. It is an intake, research, qualification and assignment system with a review cadence and a named owner at every stage.

At day 90, the VP chooses one of four outcomes

AdoptTargets met, controls working, capacity available.
ReviseControls work, but a target or workload needs adjusting.
DeferCore service would suffer. Schedule it later.
StopNo measurable benefit, or the risk is too high.

What is not a source of truth

  • A slide pasted from an old extract
  • An ad hoc query with no date or owner
  • An email total that cannot be reproduced
  • A dashboard with no definition or refresh date
  • A merged record with no audit trail

If it cannot be reproduced from the source, it is a conversation starter, not a number for the board.
